name: Soldier Fatigues
descriptionLines: &7Standard-issue spec ops gear.
&7Balanced protection with no frills.

name: Umbrella Corps Set
descriptionLines: &7Lightweight corporate tactical gear.
&7Good mobility, modest protection.

name: SWAT Set
descriptionLines: &7Police tactical gear built for close quarters.
&7Solid all-round protection for the price.

name: HECU Marine Set
descriptionLines: &7Hazardous Environment Combat Unit marine armor.
&7Sturdy and reliable in a straight firefight.

name: Astronaut Set
descriptionLines: &7Bulky space suit with a sealed helmet.
&7Good coverage but it looks like a big target.

name: Field Medic Set
descriptionLines: &7Light guard armor with a festive medic helmet.
&7Meant for staying alive while helping others.

name: NCR Ranger Set
descriptionLines: &7Heavy wasteland ranger armor.
&7Strong protection against bullets and fire.

name: Night Stalker Set
descriptionLines: &7Mercenary armor with a night vision helmet.
&7Built for hunting in the dark.

name: STARS Demolition Set
descriptionLines: &7STARS vest and boots with a Techguns combat helmet.
&7Made for explosives experts who take hits.

name: Artillery Officer Set
descriptionLines: &7Command-style officer gear with a spec ops body.
&7Made for staying behind the lines and calling in fire.

name: Pilot Set
descriptionLines: &7Light helmet with an astronaut chestpiece for pilots.
&7Pair it with a jetpack for the full flyer experience.

name: Blade Jacket Set
descriptionLines: &7Light jacket and leggings made for speed.
&7Great mobility, but no helmet and thin protection.

name: Crucible Jacket Set
descriptionLines: &7Reinforced jacket variant with depleted uranium plating.
&7Tougher than the standard Blade jacket, still helmetless.

name: Enforcer Riot Set
descriptionLines: &7Guard helmet and boots with a durable jacket.
&7Built to push forward behind a shield.

name: Ghillie Suit
descriptionLines: &7Leaves camouflage suit that blends into the terrain.
&7Great for ambushes, poor against direct fire.

name: Snow Ghillie Suit
descriptionLines: &7Snow camouflage suit that blends into the terrain.
&7Great for ambushes, poor against direct fire.

name: Dark Ghillie Suit
descriptionLines: &7Dark camouflage suit that blends into the terrain.
&7Great for ambushes, poor against direct fire.

name: Chainsaw Devil Set
descriptionLines: &7Rugged ranger armor with light leggings and boots.
&7Made for aggressive melee brawlers.

name: Biohazard Hazmat Suit
descriptionLines: &7NTM hazmat suit that shrugs off radiation and chemical hazards.
&7Little protection from bullets.

name: Heavy Hazmat Suit
descriptionLines: &7Full grey hazmat suit with very high radiation resistance.
&7The standard gear of any nuclear specialist.

name: Nuclear Containment Suit
descriptionLines: &7Grey hazmat body with a tough guard helmet.
&7Radiation protection plus better head defense.

name: Juggernaut Suit
descriptionLines: &7Mk VI helmet on a heavy spec ops frame.
&7Made to carry a minigun through anything.
